verdict.rationale: New Relic AI (docs-9, docs-10) provides in-product AI assistant for plain-language querying, troubleshooting suggestions, and query help, plus an MCP server (docs-11, docs-22) that converts natural language to NRQL for insights. This is first-party documented but lacks independent/hands-on corroboration of quality or depth of insights generated. Missing for 10: independent user validation of AI insight quality, detail on proactive/automated insight generation beyond query assistance, and depth of anomaly-detection or automated root-cause AI features.
